I started from the 10 uM well with extreme actin texture (act_std z=+69.0) and deformed small nuclei (nuc_form_factor z=-42.4, nuc_area z=-24.4 at 1 uM) plus lower density, and with visual candidates of Actin disruptors/Microtubule stabilizers and a 3-way atlas tie I anchored on cytoskeleton. - Never considered or tested DNA replication/topoisomerase mechanism because the hypothesis list and atlas focus excluded it and no EdU, DNA-damage or cell-cycle measurement was acquired.
